column1: # SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
# The Elo gauntlet's anchors, built on GitHub's runners from their official
# sources at the pinned commits (tools/gauntlet/build_anchor.sh).
# Ratings: CCRL Blitz 2'+1", single-CPU entries, list of 2026-10-31
# (computerchess.org.uk/ccrl/404/); repositories, commits, licences and build
# commands checked by research agents from each project's README, LICENSE and
# build files (no engine source opened): 2026-10-31 for the first set.
# The set of 2026-11-02 (owner): Stash 19.0 and WyldChess 1.51 dropped
# (Fork scored 92-94% against them), Marvin 6.3.0 a standing anchor (no
# longer only for a run where Fork scores over about 70% against Laser 1.7).
# Topple 0.8.1 and Seawall 20250322, the first set's alternates, left
# with them: every anchor they could replace has since built on the runners.
# Roles: continuity (built and played in an earlier gauntlet; a failed build
# stops the run), new (replaced by its alternate if its build fails),
# alternate:STEM (replaces the new anchor STEM).
# Columns, tab-separated: name, file stem, CCRL Blitz, role, repository,
# commit, build folder, build command ("make ARGS" or "cmake TARGET"), fallback
# make arguments (or -), UCI options for fastchess (or -).
Weiss 1.0
Monolith 2.01
Winter 0.9
Laser 1.7

# only the binary is ever kept, so its repository's res/ folder never sits
